parent: January two-fold RLB OOF for fit; January-to-February RLB transfer for holdout; RL on D12_I405
training_panels: first eight queue panels, no panel/link IDs as features
projection: joint v/q weighted squared correction using previously frozen panel precision; target is density per lane
